voxy.config.title: Voxy config
voxy.config.general.ingest.tooltip: Enables or disables voxies ability to convert new chunks into LoDs
voxy.config.general.quality.tooltip: How far each LoD ring lasts before its downgraded to a lower detail level
voxy.config.general.geometryBuffer.toolt: How many quads the geometry buffer can hold
voxy.config.general.maxSections.tooltip: The max number of sections the renderer can contain
voxy.config.general.renderDistance.toolt: The render distance in chunks (set to -1 to disable chunk unloading)
voxy.config.general.nvmesh.tooltip: Use nvidia mesh shaders if possible to render LoDs
voxy.config.threads.ingest.tooltip: How many threads voxy will use for ingesting new chunks
voxy.config.threads.saving.tooltip: How many threads voxy will use for saving sections to the storage backend
voxy.config.threads.render.tooltip: How many threads voxy will use for generating render data
voxy.config.general.serviceThreads.toolt: Number of threads Voxy uses for background service tasks.
voxy.config.general.useSodiumBuilder.too: Shares Sodium's builder threads for Voxy chunk building.
voxy.config.general.rendering.tooltip: Toggle rendering of distant level-of-detail sections.
voxy.config.general.vanilla_fog.tooltip: Applies vanilla fog shading onto distant LODs.
voxy.config.general.render_statistics.to: Displays advanced LOD meshes and traversal stats in F3.
voxy.config.general.show_sync_progress_b: Displays an in-game HUD progress bar displaying how far your local LOD database matches the server during streaming/sync.
